Hero.name: Léo Deroin
Hero.subtitle: Fullstack developer in Besançon
Hero.intro: Does your team need a fullstack developer who can own a Symfony backend as well as a React or Next.js frontend? Two years of apprenticeship shipping production SaaS tools at Confluent Digital, a Master's in web engineering from ESGI: I'm available for a full-time role. 40+ projects shipped — browse <projects>the gallery</projects> and see <services>what I bring</services> to a team.

Services.title: What I bring to a development team
Services.intro: Three areas where I'm productive from day one, honed over two years of apprenticeship on products running in production.

build.title: Web applications, end to end
build.problem: A feature or product to build, from the data model all the way to the interface.
build.solution: Symfony, Phalcon or Node backend, React / Next.js or Vue frontend, MySQL, Docker deployment — I cover the whole chain.
build.result: A developer who understands both sides and ships complete features.

redesign.title: Performance and modernisation
redesign.problem: Pages that are slow on mobile, code that's hard to evolve, a site that barely shows up on Google.
redesign.solution: I take over the existing code, split what needs splitting and lay a sound base: performance, technical SEO, accessibility.
redesign.result: A faster product that ranks better and is easier for the whole team to maintain.

tools.title: Business tools and SaaS
tools.problem: Teams juggling spreadsheets, copy-paste and repetitive manual tasks.
tools.solution: Back offices, dashboards, API integrations and automations — the SaaS tools I built for SMBs at Confluent Digital.
tools.result: Less manual entry, fewer errors, more time for the core business.

Services.outro: I'm looking for a full-time fullstack developer role. Browse <projects>projects already shipped</projects> or <contact>write to me</contact> — reply within 24-48h.

About.title: The fullstack developer at the controls
About.bio1: Fullstack developer based in Besançon, hooked on interfaces that step outside the lines — the kind that make you stay on a page because something is actually happening. The <lab>3D demos in the Lab</lab> are my playground.
About.bio2: I work mostly on the PHP/Symfony and JS/TS stacks (React, Next.js, Vue 3), from solid backends to polished frontend experiences. I like projects with a real reason to exist, not just a spec. My full toolbox lives on the <uses>setup page</uses>.
About.bio3: Two years of apprenticeship at Confluent Digital building SaaS tools for SMBs, a Master's in web engineering at ESGI completed in September 2026 — and still too much time spent animating shaders. I'm now looking for a full-time role: what I'm busy with is on <now>the Now page</now>, and what I learn ends up on <blog>the blog</blog>.

Lab.metaTitle: Lab — Three.js, R3F and GLSL shader demos
Lab.metaDescription: Interactive Three.js / R3F demos: procedural planet, fbm noise field, attractive particles. GLSL shaders with live controls.
Lab.title: 3D Lab: Three.js demos
Lab.intro: Three isolated Three.js / R3F demos. Everything is shader-based or geometry-based, no texture loaded. Touch the sliders, the effect is instant. The same approach drives <home>the planet on the home page</home>; technical write-ups land on <blog>the blog</blog>.
Lab.why: The lab is where I test interface ideas before bringing them into a real project: WebGL animations, data visualisations, scroll effects. If your team builds that kind of experience, <contact>let's talk</contact>.

planet.title: Procedural planet
planet.description: Shader-based sphere — 5-octave fbm for continents, polar caps, fresnel atmosphere, wrap-Lambert for soft terminator. No texture, everything computed on GPU.

noise.title: Noise field
noise.description: Ortho plane with fragment shader — 2D fbm with configurable octaves, time drift, color ramp and soft vignette. The pattern shifts dramatically with frequency.

particles.title: Particle attractor
particles.description: 1500 points with inverse-square attraction toward the cursor. Minimal shader for the twinkle, Newtonian friction, soft bounds. Toggle attract / repel.
particles.hint: Move your cursor over the area
